note: Authored governing specification for the process-guidance COMPONENT inside an official-form track — the LegalEase participant guide that closes the assembled Maryland shielding packet. The specification generator emits guidance specs for a guidance track and for the guidance units of a composed route; a guidance component of an official_pdf_fill track matches neither shape and would otherwise report no governing specification. As in Tranche 1, the gate is closed by drafting the specification rather than by emitting an empty one.
appliesTo: Only the component listed. No other track is affected.

specifications.scope: How to execute, assemble and file the two completed official Maryland forms in this packet: what the participant must sign and date by hand, what to confirm against Maryland Judiciary Case Search before filing, where and how to file in the single elected court and county, how to verify the filing fee at the counter rather than relying on a printed amount, who serves the State's Attorney and the victims, which supporting records to bring, what happens in the thirty days after filing, and the conditions under which the participant should stop and get a lawyer.
specifications.notAFiling: The guide is not a court filing and is not part of the normalized Maryland packet set. Only CC-DC-CR-148 and MDJ-008 are filed. The guide is bound into the same assembled PDF so the participant has one document, and it says so on its face.
